name: Arcane City: Lyn;Lin
source:
Caleeca ('The Virgin') stars in a story of her very own!

It has been several years since Lin Caleeca left the Asylum and changed her career. A dark mystery awaits her and will test her on every level.

[From[url=https://arcanecity.itch.io/arcane-city-lynlin]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《The Virgin》中的卡莉卡，终于成为了属于她自己的故事的主角！

林·卡莉卡离开精神病院、转行至今，已经过去了数年。一个黑暗的谜团正在等待着她，将在各方面考验她。

[摘自[url=https://arcanecity.itch.io/arcane-city-lynlin]Itch.io[/url]]
